WITH DISTINCT p
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality, DATE_DIFF('year', CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE), CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN CAST('2026-10-15' AS DATE) ELSE CAST(p.death_date AS DATE) END) AS age

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality, p.birth_date AS birth_date, COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/15') AS end_date
WITH nationality,
     CAST(SPLIT(end_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) - CAST(SPLIT(birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) -
     CASE
       WHEN CAST(SPLIT(end_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) < CAST(SPLIT(birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64)
         OR (CAST(SPLIT(end_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) = CAST(SPLIT(birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64)
             AND CAST(SPLIT(end_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) < CAST(SPLIT(birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MAX(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
     CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/15'), '/', '-') AS DATE) AS end_date
WITH nationality,
     DATE_PART('year', end_date) - DATE_PART('year', birth_date) -
     CASE
       WHEN DATE_PART('month', end_date) < DATE_PART('month', birth_date)
         OR (DATE_PART('month', end_date) = DATE_PART('month', birth_date)
             AND DATE_PART('day', end_date) < DATE_PART('day', birth_date))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MAX(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.birth_date, '^([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]+/([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]+/[0-9]+/([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_day,
     COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/15') AS end_date
WITH nationality, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
     CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(end_date, '^([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) AS end_year,
     CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(end_date, '^[0-9]+/([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) AS end_month,
     CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(end_date, '^[0-9]+/[0-9]+/([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) AS end_day
WITH nationality,
     end_year - birth_year - CASE
       WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MAX(age) AS col2
